decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template builds on the firm's shop hosting know-how and costs little to maintain, but it has not been visible since 2018 and minor templates are easily retired as shop platforms evolve.
The responsive template sits close to CMS expertise but has been unobserved since 2018 and adds little strategic learning, so withdrawal is roughly as likely as retention.

The version management tool draws directly on the firm's own software development and fits its strategy of tools that cut recurring operational work, so the firm can interpret its use and keep improving it.

The data processing contract tool lies outside the firm's hosting knowledge base, which limits its ability to develop it further, yet it still serves an ongoing GDPR need of agency customers at low cost.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship built on the firm's core hosting, data center and support know-how, giving it strong capacity to learn from results and refine the product.
